description: This file defines a Java class `DrugValidator` which implements validation logic for `Drug` objects within the OpenMRS project. It checks for valid mappings, non-null references, proper field lengths, and prevents duplicate term mappings.

classes.name: DrugValidator
classes.description: Validator class for `Drug` objects, ensuring mappings and fields adhere to constraints and preventing duplicate reference term mappings.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the class type `Drug`.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a `Drug` object, its reference maps, and related sub-objects, applying various validation rules such as non-null references, proper field lengths, and avoiding duplicate term mappings.
